about: What each measured Octatrack module adds to the frame interrupt's share, in percent of a frame: `use` on each track or slot it takes, `wake` once when it wakes from resting (3 % when not measured; 0 where `use` was read on a first pick from rest, which holds it). The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h); the base judges every module pick by the frame share it would play at, against mw_frame_line (status.c). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price, an effect nothing, and a wake 3 %. Measured with `npm run device -- guard` on a unit, same Part, before and after one pick; when two disagree, keep the one taken from a Part under the line (50 %), as past it the guard's drops distort the figure, else the larger. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.
